messages.content: The museum has confirmed that Friday’s unpacking is at the annex, not the main building. It is several blocks away. Can you check the route from the hotel, confirm that the hotel will hold my carry-on after checkout, and work backward from my flight?
Yes. What time are you expected at the annex, and do you know whether the receiving team has a firm end time for the unpacking?

I need to be there at 8:30 a.m. They expect to finish by 3:00 p.m., but I want a little protection if it runs over. The annex entrance is on Laclede Avenue, about six blocks east of the main museum entrance.

From MetroLink Hotel Central West End, the annex is about a 12-minute walk. A rideshare would usually take 5 to 10 minutes, but morning traffic and pickup time could erase much of that advantage. Leaving the hotel at 8:10 a.m. gives you a few minutes to locate the correct entrance before the 8:30 call.
That works. Please check the luggage part directly. I only have one carry-on, and I’ll need to retrieve it before heading to the airport.

The hotel has confirmed complimentary luggage storage for your carry-on after Friday checkout. Leave it with the front desk, retain the claim ticket, and collect it later that afternoon. This does not change your reservation or create an added charge.
Now set the afternoon timing. Remember that the booked return leaves St. Louis at 5:55 p.m.; it is the Nashville connection, not the old nonstop.

For the confirmed 5:55 p.m. one-stop return under ATL7QK, plan to leave the annex by 3:20 p.m. Walk back to the hotel and retrieve the bag by about 3:40, then request a car immediately. With an estimated airport arrival around 4:15, you should have roughly 1 hour 40 minutes before departure. If unpacking is still active at 3:10, tell the receiving team you must wrap up and depart no later than 3:20.
Good. Give me the final Friday sequence in one place.

Friday, July 18: check out of MetroLink Hotel Central West End and leave your carry-on with the front desk by 8:10 a.m.; walk to the Laclede Avenue annex for the 8:30 a.m. unpacking call; finish by 3:00 p.m. if possible and leave no later than 3:20; return to the hotel, claim the carry-on by about 3:40, and depart for the airport immediately. Target airport arrival is approximately 4:15 p.m. for the booked 5:55 p.m. St. Louis departure connecting in Nashville and arriving in Atlanta at 10:38 p.m. The former 6:20 p.m. nonstop is not part of the itinerary.
